rationale: Same trip and records as C-0001; the rider's 14:02 reply was a voice message that the intake transcribed ('Okay, sure, go ahead. Can you stop at a 711 on the way? ...') and filed as chat #2. Two off-route segments (RD-1). Segment 1 (14:10–14:15, +1.85 km, Orchard Road → Cavenagh Road → Bras Basah Road) is exempt: it bypasses the Orchard Road stretch (optimal km 0.8–1.6) on which an accident was reported at 13:52, before the segment started, with Orchard Road in speed band 1 (RD-4); the driver also proposed 'go round by Cavenagh' at 14:01 and the rider agreed at 14:02 by voice message, read from the transcript (RD-5). Segment 2 (14:17–14:29, +2.87 km) contains the 7-Eleven stop on Beach Road, 1.27 km off the route (the segment reaches 1.55 km from it); the rider asked for 'a 7-Eleven on the way' without naming a place and the driver never said he would drive out to Beach Road, so the segment is not exempt (RD-3(b), RD-5 scope). Refund = 2.87 km x $1.41/km (distance fare ÷ distance km) = $4.05 (RD-2). The 4 min 10 s stop is billed as RydeTAXI meter waiting ($1.08) and stays (RD-3(c)). No flag: driver has 0 route disputes upheld in 90 d (RD-6 not met).
